## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete behavior and synthetic reproduction.

## Validation

Record checks and exact candidate scope; do not attach raw evidence.

- [ ] No credentials, real histories, private paths or business data
- [ ] Required tests and affected safety invariants pass
- [ ] Claims, compatibility and documentation match the change
- [ ] Dependency/packaging changes include updated locks and notices

External contributions require prior owner coordination under CONTRIBUTING.md.
